lines: The Supreme Lord himself — through the door
of the guru's body-abode — graces the to-be-graced.
l4.sanskrit_cite: parameśvara eva hi guruśarīrādhiṣṭhānadvāreṇa anugrāhyān anugṛhṇāti

c1_essence: By the guru's body-abode door the Supreme Lord graces those to be graced — of unthinkable glory, mostly said.
